purpose: Re-open only the public CNInfo category-metadata frontier after the zero-network post-CCASS Tushare audit, and select at most one economically independent three-session mechanism before requesting any announcement row, announcement identity, factor value, price, or return.

post_ccass_tushare_and_local_broker_fron.scope_note: That audit remains authoritative for the reviewed Tushare and local QMT/XTQuant routes. This re-audit adds only the official public CNInfo category metadata that it did not review; it does not reopen any rejected provider, factor, or source contract.

category_mechanism_review.economic_mechanism: Recent supplementary or corrective disclosures are an observable reporting-control and disclosure-reliability burden. Among issuers with an active event, fewer notices and greater elapsed time since the latest notice are frozen as the more resilient direction.
category_mechanism_review.independence: The source event is the act of supplementing or correcting a disclosure, not an earnings result, valuation ratio, ownership change, management trade, financing flow, contract, subsidy, guarantee, audit opinion, report publication lead time, or price transform.

category_mechanism_review.reason: The category mixes rumor clarification and apology semantics; without title reading it is not one economic mechanism, while title mining would reopen the already observed markup and post-result classifier risk.
Generic risk warnings mix trading, delisting, litigation, operation, and financing states and overlap terminal ST/risk and announcement mechanisms without a title-independent identity.

Routine meeting volume is not a directional mechanism by itself; narrower personnel, ownership, guarantee, incentive, and governance events overlap already terminal branches or require title semantics.
The category is too broad without title classification and contains mechanisms already terminally tested through contracts, subsidies, related-party transactions, and operating disclosures.
These financing, unlock, and ownership categories are provider/category variants of already exhausted supply, financing, ownership, and capital-structure mechanisms.

selected_candidate.availability: Each announcement becomes effective only at the first local trading-session close strictly after its Shanghai calendar date; entry can occur no earlier than the following local open.
selected_candidate.absence_policy: An issuer with no active category event is missing, never a zero-burden or perfect-resilience value.
selected_candidate.interpretation_boundary: The factor ranks only recently affected issuers by relative supplement/correction burden. It does not label unaffected issuers, infer why a filing changed, or claim fraud, accounting error, or restatement severity.
selected_candidate.title_policy: Do not read, normalize, classify, persist, or hash announcementTitle. The exact official category is the complete semantic selector.
selected_candidate.identity_policy: Read only secCode, announcementTime, and announcementId. Treat instrument plus announcementId as the event identity; allow one announcementId to be explicitly mapped by the provider to more than one supported instrument; collapse only exact repeated identities with the same date and reject conflicting dates.

hard_capacity_plausibility_before_rows.reason: The official category is event-dated rather than monthly or quarterly, so its calendar structure does not cap it below 200. This is only a hard upper-bound screen; source density, cross-sectional variation, quality/listing eligibility, and actual cohort capacity remain unknown until their frozen no-return gates run.

decision.next_required_action: Freeze a credential-free source and sample-variation contract with exact category, three fields, identity policy, pagination, point-in-time universe, formula, thresholds, atomic publication, and one-shot guard before requesting any announcement row or factor value.
